edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into by and between Vireo Systems Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), and the Executive identified on the signature page hereto (the “Executive”).
edits.name: Parties clause

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer and shall report to the Chief Executive Officer. The Executive shall devote substantially all business time, attention, and efforts to the performance of the Executive’s duties and shall comply with all lawful policies and directions of the Company.
edits.name: Position clause

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary as approved by the Board or its compensation committee from time to time (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, and shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of such plans.
edits.name: Compensation clause

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims and continued compliance with this Agreement, the Executive shall receive the severance benefits set forth in the applicable exhibit or schedule to this Agreement, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and applicable law.
edits.name: Severance clause

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During employment and for twelve (12) months following the Executive’s separation from service, the Executive shall not, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, engage in any competitive activity that is materially adverse to the Company within the geographic area and business lines in which the Executive had material responsibility during the final twelve (12) months of employment. The Executive shall also comply with customary confidentiality, non-solicitation, non-disparagement, and return-of-property obligations.
edits.name: Restrictive covenants clause

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary at a rate not less than $[AGREED OFFER AMOUNT] per year, as may be increased from time to time by the Board or its compensation committee (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices. The Executive shall be eligible to earn an annual target cash bonus equal to [__]% of Base Salary, subject to achievement of applicable Company and individual performance goals as determined by the Board or its compensation committee. The Executive shall also be eligible to receive an initial equity award with a target grant-date value of $[__], subject to approval by the Board or its compensation committee and the terms of the Company’s equity incentive plan and applicable award agreement. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of such plans.
edits.name: Compensation concrete economics

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, then, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and continued compliance with this Agreement, the Executive shall receive: (a) continued payment of twelve (12) months of the then-current Base Salary, payable in substantially equal installments in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices; (b) an amount equal to the Executive’s target annual bonus for the year of termination, payable in substantially equal installments over the same twelve (12)-month period or, if required by applicable law or the Company’s standard practice, in a lump sum at the time annual bonuses are generally paid; and (c) subject to the Executive’s timely election of continuation coverage under COBRA, Company-paid COBRA premiums for the Executive and eligible dependents for up to twelve (12) months following termination, or until the Executive becomes eligible for comparable coverage from another employer, if earlier. For purposes of this Agreement, “Good Reason” means, without the Executive’s consent: (i) a material reduction in Base Salary; (ii) a material diminution in authority, duties, or responsibilities; (iii) a requirement that the Executive relocate the Executive’s principal place of employment by more than fifty (50) miles; or (iv) a material breach of this Agreement by the Company, in each case subject to the Executive providing written notice within thirty (30) days after the event, the Company having thirty (30) days to cure, and the Executive resigning within sixty (60) days after the cure period expires if not cured.
edits.name: Severance without Cause or Good Reason

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall at all times protect and not use or disclose the Company’s confidential information except as required in the performance of the Executive’s duties for the Company or as required by law. Upon termination of employment, the Executive shall promptly return or delete Company property and confidential information in the Executive’s possession or control, subject to ordinary-course archival copies and applicable law. During employment and for twelve (12) months following termination, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly: (a) solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the final twelve (12) months of employment; or (b) solicit any customer, client, or active prospect of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the final twelve (12) months of employment for the purpose of diverting business that is competitive with products or services for which the Executive had material responsibility. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits the Executive from engaging in lawful employment or business activities after termination, and there shall be no post-employment non-competition covenant or restriction on undefined “competitive activity.” The Executive shall also comply with customary non-disparagement obligations, provided that nothing herein restricts truthful statements required by law, participation in government proceedings, or rights under applicable whistleblower laws.
edits.name: Narrowed restrictive covenants
